description: Source code for a JSON document loader component in a larger software project, implementing classes for loading and parsing JSON files with support for metadata extraction, pointers, and document splitting.

classes.name: Json_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Implements a JSON file loader with support for metadata extraction, pointers, and document splitting, conforming to the INode interface.

classes.name: TextLoader
classes.description: Base class for loading text content from file paths or blobs, providing parsing and loading functionalities.

classes.name: JSONLoader
classes.description: Extends TextLoader to parse JSON content, extract data based on pointers, and handle both single objects and arrays with options for separating by object.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the loader, processes input files, applies text splitting, and prepares documents with optional metadata.

methods.name: removeValuesStartingWithSlash
methods.description: Removes key-value pairs from an object where the value is a string starting with '/'.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and parses the document content, returning an array of Document objects or concatenated text.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses raw JSON string into Document objects, handling both single and array JSON structures, with optional separation by object.

methods.name: extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content from JSON based on specified pointers or all strings if no pointers are provided.

methods.name: extractMetadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata from JSON objects based on a mapping configuration, supporting JSON pointers.

methods.name: formatObjectAsKeyValue
methods.description: Recursively formats a JSON object into a human-readable key-value string.

methods.name: extractArrayStringsFromObject
methods.description: Recursively extracts strings from JSON objects based on pointers, supporting extraction of all strings or targeted nodes.

methods.name: getTargetedEntries
methods.description: Retrieves targeted entries from a JSON object based on JSON pointers.
